I recently visited Nakoda Bhairav Foundation in Kandivali West and was very impressed with their services. The staff are polite, welcoming, and always ready to help. The centre is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with modern diagnostic facilities.

I had a dental RC treatment done by Dr. Pooja, and the entire procedure was carried out very smoothly. She is highly knowledgeable, calm, and caring, ensuring patients feel comfortable throughout the treatment. The charges here are very affordable compared to outside clinics, not only for dental care but also for other diagnostic tests.

Overall, Nakoda Bhairav Foundation is a highly reliable and cost-effective healthcare centre. I would definitely recommend it to everyone in the area!

featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Dhabalia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst service ever... Scheduled USG for abdomen.. took full money in advance and scheduled appointment at 12pm for the next day. However, after reaching the centre on time after an hour they inform us that the doctor will not come. That too post so much of follow up . Now that we asked for a refund, they say it will take 3-5 working days.. no sense of accountability at all.. medical negligence by radiologist can cause the patient so much.

Would really want necessary action taken against the radiologist scheduled for 24th May 2026.
